name: stylevault
description: StyleVault: Africa's news, in its own style. A continent-wide news reader and personal monitor covering all 54 African countries.

scripts.setup: npm run db:migrate && npm run db:seed
scripts.db:seed: node scripts/build-seed.mjs && wrangler d1 execute stylevault --local --file db/seed.sql
scripts.db:seed:remote: node scripts/build-seed.mjs && wrangler d1 execute stylevault --remote --file db/seed.sql
